messages.text:
I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed reduced motion for the cards and win banner. Card border transitions and the banner pulse are disabled when the system preference is set to reduce, including when it changes while the game is open.

The fresh build, all 138 unit tests and all three motion browser checks passed. In the full browser suite, 77 journeys passed and one face-sheet check timed out; that check passed when rerun on its own.

The changed files pass formatting checks. The repository-wide formatting check still reports 13 unrelated files.
